text: オツキミやまの　ふもと　からは　４ばん　どうろよ

structure.jp: オツキミやまの　ふもと　からは
structure.en: from the foot of Mt. Moon onward

patterns.name: 〜から
patterns.explanation: から after a place means 'from' that point; the added は sets it apart from the part before it. ふもと からは = 'from the foot onward'.

patterns.name: 〜だ
patterns.explanation: In women's speech the word for 'is' can be dropped and よ put straight after the thing. ４ばん どうろよ = 'it's Route 4'.
